title: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.24628v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure. The model accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs, was trained on data from over a hundred languages, and is quantized to approximately 4-bit precision for efficient single-GPU inference. Muse Glimmer achieves state-of-the-art performance for its size class on agentic benchmarks, setting a new standard compared to the models of its size: Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use, multi-step planning, and agentic task completion. We release the model under the Apache 2.0 license to foster open-source development of capable, safe, local AI agents.

translated_title: Muse Glimmer 30B：一个端侧智能体模型
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了Muse Glimmer，这是一个开源的300亿参数因果语言模型，配备感知编码器，专为在消费级硬件上执行自主智能体任务而打造。Muse Glimmer将多步推理、可靠的工具使用和故障恢复能力集成到单一模型中，可在消费级设备上本地运行，无需依赖云端基础设施。该模型接受文本和图像输入并产生文本输出，训练数据涵盖一百多种语言，并被量化至约4比特精度以实现高效的单GPU推理。Muse Glimmer在智能体基准测试中取得了同规模模型中的最先进性能，在工具使用、多步规划和智能体任务完成方面，相比同规模模型Gemma4-31B和Qwen3.6-27B树立了新标准。我们以Apache 2.0许可证发布该模型，以促进功能强大、安全、本地化AI智能体的开源发展。
tldr: Muse Glimmer是一个开源的30B参数端侧智能体模型，集成了多步推理、可靠的工具使用和故障恢复能力，可在消费级硬件上本地运行且无需云端，并在智能体基准测试中超越Gemma4-31B和Qwen3.6-27B等同规模模型达到最先进性能。
en_tdlr: Muse Glimmer is an open-source 30B parameter on-device agentic model that integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use, and failure recovery to run locally on consumer hardware without cloud infrastructure, achieving state-of-the-art agentic benchmark performance over same-size models like Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B.
